primaryObjective: Determine whether raw color evidence can become one defensible, typed, cross-source descriptive assessment without converting absence, ambiguous prose, luminosity, material color, or compound observations into exact object-color claims.
hypothesis: The 79,215 catalog rows carrying raw color evidence across NUFORC and UFOCAT contain enough explicit object-color or light-color vocabulary to normalize at least 63,372 rows into conservative typed roles while preserving original text, ambiguity, compound colors, and source-specific semantics.

selectionRationale.reason: Color is the only remaining typed-observation module already marked candidate_audit_ready, exceeds the 5 percent coverage floor, and has two independently identified sources. Sound and light remain single-source; behavior and evidence have no pinned raw-field coverage.

inScope: deterministic audit of exact raw color values, source coverage, missingness, sentinels, and high-frequency forms
one conservative typed color-role normalization sidecar with original-value hashes and parse reasons
explicit separation of object color, emitted-light color, multicolor, color change, unknown role, and unparsed text
cross-source descriptive readiness and source-era-region support checks
one compact color assessment only if every material gate passes
JSON and CSV evidence export with hashes and suppression state
outOfScope: canonical event mutation or free-text description mining
inferring color from craft type, brightness, illumination, photographs, or chronology prose
collapsing object color and emitted-light color into one scientific variable
treating missing, blank, none, unknown, or unparsed values as negative observations
sound, light-presence, behavior, evidence, solar, weather, or lunar assessments
authenticity, incidence, risk, causal, or Pattern Finder claims

estimators: source-era-region common-support standardized active/reference share difference only for role-compatible categories
deterministic 95 percent bootstrap interval when cross-source stability gates pass
negativeControls: blank, none, unknown, ambiguous, compound, changing, and unparsed values remain distinct
readinessContract.uncertaintyTreatment: Exact single colors, explicit compound colors, changing colors, object-color roles, emitted-light-color roles, ambiguous roles, non-color descriptors, source sentinels, and unparsed text remain distinct. No value is inferred from descriptions or neighboring fields.
readinessContract.suppressionPolicy: Publish a compact readiness result instead of an assessment whenever typed coverage, source independence, role compatibility, common support, cell support, or holdout stability fails. Never treat missing color as colorless or zero.

releaseGates: raw-value audit and preregistered parser rules before production code
normalization idempotence, original-value preservation, and source occurrence parity
role-compatible projection parity and deterministic hashes
statistical determinism, common support, FDR isolation, and holdout stability
no raw-count-driven inference and no Color Pattern Finder promotion
Pages and immutable R2 separation if a large sidecar is accepted
desktop and mobile browser QA, keyboard, themes, reduced motion, exports, direct hashes, and zero console errors
identical frozen Pages package preview to production and tested rollback
stopConditions: fewer than 63372 rows normalize without description mining or semantic guessing
fewer than two sources retain at least 1000 normalized rows
object color and emitted-light color cannot be separated deterministically
compound, changing, unknown, or source sentinel semantics would be weakened
the assessment requires a second browser event model
scientific, provenance, rights, accessibility, or performance gates would need weakening
